WITH account_averages AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) as avg_amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
),
frequency_means AS (
  SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amount) as frequency_mean
  FROM account_averages
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT aa.account_id, aa.frequency, aa.avg_amount, aa.avg_amount / fm.frequency_mean as ratio
FROM account_averages aa
JOIN frequency_means fm ON aa.frequency = fm.frequency
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
